summary: Resource-check dispatcher: initializes this via F_5FieldInit, then calls the vtable slot at offset 28 of the object pointed to by global dword_7CD8C0 with selector argument 12, and if a non-null object is returned, compares its name against this via ObjectNameComparison. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Indirect call through vtable slot 28 of the object at global dword_7CD8C0, passing (dword_7CD8C0, 12); the slot behaves as an allocator/factory taking a selector.
Guard on the object returned by the vtable call being non-null.
If the returned object is non-null, call ObjectNameComparison(returnedObject, this) to compare object names.

unresolved: Type and contract of the object behind global dword_7CD8C0 and its vtable slot 28 (called with selector 12) are unknown.
